name: Telo

attributes.attribute: a Continental Celtic goddess, or possibly a god
honored by inscriptions to the healing spirit of the spring at Toulon
located in the French region of the Dordogne

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Telo is a Continental Celtic goddess. This name appears on inscriptions. The inscriptions honor the healing power of the spring at Toulon. The site sits in the French region of the Dordogne. Some believe the name marks a goddess. Telo may in truth have been a god.

okr.objective: Describe the Continental Celtic deity Telo.
key_results: The name Telo is found on inscriptions at Toulon in the Dordogne.
It honors the healing spirit of the spring there.
The name may mark a goddess, although Telo may have been a god.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
